cd /home/groscoe/Projects/home-manager-config
/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix develop --no-update-lock-file .#c --command bash -c 'set -eu
build_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/hm-restore-c.XXXXXX)
cd "$build_dir"
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'#include <stdio.h>'"'"' '"'"'int main(void){puts("recovery-c-ok");return 0;}'"'"' > main.c
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'AC_INIT([recovery],[1.0])'"'"' '"'"'AM_INIT_AUTOMAKE([foreign])'"'"' '"'"'AC_PROG_CC'"'"' '"'"'LT_INIT'"'"' '"'"'AC_CONFIG_FILES([Makefile])'"'"' '"'"'AC_OUTPUT'"'"' > configure.ac
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'noinst_PROGRAMS = recovery'"'"' '"'"'recovery_SOURCES = main.c'"'"' > Makefile.am
autoreconf -fi
./configure --quiet
make --quiet
test "$(./recovery)" = recovery-c-ok
printf '"'"'Compiler: %s\n'"'"' "$CC"
"$CC" --version | head -1
pkg-config --version
gdb --batch -ex run -ex quit ./recovery
'

desktop-session-setup:
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'PYGUI'
from pathlib import Path
import os
wrapper=Path('/usr/local/bin/hm-i3-session')
assert not wrapper.exists() or wrapper.read_text() == '#!/bin/sh\nexec /etc/X11/Xsession \"$HOME/.nix-profile/bin/i3\"\n'
wrapper.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexec /etc/X11/Xsession "$HOME/.nix-profile/bin/i3"\n')
wrapper.chmod(0o755)
sessions=Path('/usr/share/xsessions');sessions.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
entry=sessions/'hm-i3.desktop'
assert not entry.exists() or 'Name=Home Manager i3' in entry.read_text()
entry.write_text('[Desktop Entry]\nName=Home Manager i3\nComment=Declared user i3 session through Ubuntu Xsession\nExec=/usr/local/bin/hm-i3-session\nTryExec=/usr/local/bin/hm-i3-session\nType=Application\nDesktopNames=i3;\n')
entry.chmod(0o644)
state=Path('/var/lib/sddm/state.conf')
state.write_text('[Last]\nSession=hm-i3.desktop\nUser=groscoe\n')
state.chmod(0o644)
PYGUI
sudo -n systemctl set-default graphical.target
sudo -n systemctl enable --now sddm.service
systemctl is-active sddm.service
virtual-monitor-adaptation:
/usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'PYBAR'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
home=Path('/home/groscoe')
target=home/'restore-smoke/polybar'
if not target.exists(): shutil.copytree(home/'.config/polybar/material',target)
file=target/'config.ini'
file.chmod(0o600)
text=file.read_text()
assert 'monitor = DP-1-8' in text or 'monitor = Virtual-1' in text
file.write_text(text.replace('monitor = DP-1-8','monitor = Virtual-1').replace('monitor-fallback = eDP-1','monitor-fallback = Virtual-1'))
PYBAR
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'PYUNIT'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/etc/systemd/user/polybar.service.d');p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(p/'restore-test.conf').write_text('[Service]\nExecStart=\nExecStart=/home/groscoe/.nix-profile/bin/polybar --log=warning --config=/home/groscoe/restore-smoke/polybar/config.ini main\n')
PYUNIT
systemctl --user daemon-reload
if systemctl --user is-failed --quiet polybar.service; then systemctl --user reset-failed polybar.service; fi

sleep 2
systemctl --user is-active polybar picom dunst xsettingsd ssh-agent

home-manager-rollback:
RECOVERY_BASELINE=$(readlink -f /home/groscoe/.local/state/nix/profiles/home-manager)
cd /home/groscoe/Projects/home-manager-config
cp hosts/xps/home.nix /tmp/recovery-home-original.nix
/usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'PYHM'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('hosts/xps/home.nix');t=p.read_text()
assert '  imports = [' in t
p.write_text(t.replace('  imports = [','  home.file.".recovery-rollback-fixture".text = "synthetic generation test\\n";\n  imports = [',1))
PYHM
variant=$(/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix build --no-link --print-out-paths --no-update-lock-file .#homeConfigurations.xps.activationPackage)
"$variant/activate"
test -L /home/groscoe/.recovery-rollback-fixture
cp /tmp/recovery-home-original.nix hosts/xps/home.nix
${RECOVERY_BASELINE}/activate
test ! -e /home/groscoe/.recovery-rollback-fixture
test "$(readlink -f /home/groscoe/.local/state/nix/profiles/home-manager)" = ${RECOVERY_BASELINE}
${RECOVERY_BASELINE}/activate
nix-native-rollback:
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 -I - <<'PYNIX'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
source=Path('/home/groscoe/Projects/home-manager-config/hosts/xps/ubuntu/nix_startup.py')
backups=sorted(Path('/var/backups').glob('xps-nix-startup-*'),key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime)[:1]
assert backups
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I',str(backups[0]/'nix_startup.py'),'rollback',str(backups[0])],check=True)
p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I',str(source),'check'],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert p.returncode==1,(p.stdout,p.stderr)
print('Original installer definitions restored; drift detected')
subprocess.run(['systemctl','stop','nix-daemon.socket','nix-daemon.service'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I',str(source),'apply'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I',str(source),'check'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['systemctl','start','nix-daemon.socket'],check=True)
PYNIX
/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix store info --store daemon
